primary.title: Want to retire early? How to split ₹1 lakh in monthly investments between short-term goals and FIRE, expert explains
primary.summary: Early retirement requires balancing short-term financial goals with long-term wealth creation. Expert explains how to allocate ₹70,000 or ₹1 lakh in monthly investments towards FIRE, account for inflation and choose an appropriate equity-debt mix to build a retirement corpus.
